resources.string: They will no longer receive new messages.
Not saved: %1$s Remove the Nextcloud file again to keep writing.
Nextcloud files of other people can\'t be copied into other pages.
Only visible on the page\'s server (sharing with connected servers is off).
Not available – unlinked, no access anymore or file deleted.
Too large for the app – please open it in Nextcloud.
Nextcloud found. Sign in there and allow access – Saga gets its own app password (Saga never sees your password).
Link your own Nextcloud to insert files from it into pages (“+” in the toolbar → “Nextcloud file”). Saga gets its own app password – Saga never sees your password.
This server doesn’t support Nextcloud files yet (Saga 2.3 or later).
Nextcloud files are turned off on this server.
Everyone who can see a page also sees the Nextcloud files you inserted there. If you unlink, your inserted files only show a card without content.
Saga revokes the app password; files you inserted will no longer show any content.

Back up your own workspace, encrypted, to your own Nextcloud or another WebDAV target. Only what belongs to you is included – what others shared with you stays out. Readable only with your private key, even without Saga.
This server doesn’t support personal backups yet (Saga 2.3 or later).
Personal backups are turned off on this server.
Still missing for backups: a target and at least one public key.
No backups at the target yet.
This target is not (or no longer) allowed – please connect again.
Connection OK. Free space at the target: %1$s.

Nextcloud: just enter the address – you then sign in at Nextcloud. Other WebDAV: address of the folder plus user and password. Only https addresses on the internet (internal servers only if the admin allows them).
No key yet – Saga doesn\'t back up without a key.
A generated key is still waiting for confirmation (e.g. in the browser).
Pages and subpages (incl. databases with entries)
Your own comments on your pages
Comments by other people on my pages
Off by default – the comments belong to the people who wrote them.
Never included: pages and files of other people (including \"Shared with me\") and chats – they are end-to-end encrypted and belong to everyone involved.
None – all your pages are backed up.
The newest backups stay at the target, Saga deletes older ones. At most %1$d MB per backup.
Restoring works in the browser: Saga on the web → Settings → My backup → “Restore backup”. Existing pages stay unchanged.
Existing backups at the target are kept. An app password from the Nextcloud login is revoked.
New backups will then no longer be readable with it. Older backups stay readable with it.
New private key – shown only now and not stored by Saga:
Store it in a safe place (password manager, printout) – not on this server. Without it your backups cannot be restored.
To confirm: the last 6 characters of the private key
Key is stored safely – add it
